digo: Chinuka cha m'masai; Mnuka lovu; Mtsatsa
other_mijikenda: Duruma, Giriama, Swahili: share the name mtsatsa (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: Crush a leaf and you will understand all three of its names: two of them are about its bad smell.
teaser.sw: Ponda jani lake na utaelewa majina yake yote matatu: mawili kati yake yanahusu harufu yake mbaya.
teaser.dg: Hopeza kodza na undamanya mana ya madzinage gosi mahahu: mairi kahi yao ni ga arufuye mbii.

summary.en: *Chinuka cha m'masai* is a shrub or small tree whose crushed leaves smell unpleasant. Two of its Digo names are about that smell, and one draws on an old rivalry.
summary.sw: *Chinuka cha m'masai* ni kichaka au mti mdogo ambao majani yake yakipondwa hutoa harufu mbaya. Majina yake mawili ya Kidigo yanahusu harufu hiyo, na moja linatokana na uhasama wa zamani.
summary.dg: *Chinuka cha m'masai* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide ambao makodzage ganaphohopezwa ganalavya arufu mbii. Madzinage mairi ga Chidigo ni ga arufu hiyo, na rimwenga rinatuluka kpwa kondo za kare.

about.en: *Clerodendrum glabrum* is a shrub or small tree with smooth, glossy leaves, often in whorls of three, that give off a strong, unpleasant smell when crushed. It bears dense, rounded heads of small, sweet-scented white to pinkish flowers with long stamens, followed by round, whitish-yellow fruits. Digo identify it by the look of its leaves and their smell.
about.sw: *Clerodendrum glabrum* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani laini yanayong'aa, mara nyingi katika duara za matatu, ambayo hutoa harufu kali mbaya yanapopondwa. Huzaa vichwa vizito vya mviringo vya maua madogo meupe hadi ya waridi hafifu yenye harufu tamu na stameni ndefu, yanayofuatwa na matunda ya mviringo ya rangi nyeupe-manjano. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya majani yake na harufu yake.
about.dg: *Clerodendrum glabrum* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza laini ganayong'ala, mara nyinji mahahu mahahu phatu phamwenga, ganayolavya arufu kali mbii ganaphohopezwa. Chinalavya mafungu ga mviringo ga maruwa madide manji phamwenga, genye arufu nono, mereru hadi ga pinki, na *stamens* zenye ure mkulu, na badaye matunda ga mviringo, ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu. Adigo anachimanya kpwa umbo ra makodzage na arufu yao.

where.en: It is widespread in bushland, thicket, woodland and coastal forest margins from East Africa to southern Africa.
where.sw: Unapatikana kwa wingi katika vichaka, vichaka vizito, misitu ya wazi na pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani kuanzia Afrika Mashariki hadi kusini mwa Afrika.
where.dg: Chinaphahikana sana weruni, vitsakani, matsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka ga pwani, kula Afrika Mashariki hadi kusini mwa Afrika.

culture.en: Pakia records that the name *chinuka cha m'masai*, 'the Maasai-smelling plant', ties the plant's bad smell to the Maasai. He suggests this comes from the belief that the Maasai were 'not good', having been enemies of the Digo in historical fights.
culture.sw: Pakia ameandika kwamba jina *chinuka cha m'masai*, 'mmea unaonuka kama Mmaasai', linahusisha harufu mbaya ya mmea huu na Wamaasai. Anapendekeza kwamba hili linatokana na imani kwamba Wamaasai 'hawakuwa wema', kwa kuwa walikuwa maadui wa Wadigo katika vita vya kihistoria.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala dzina *chinuka cha m'masai*, 'chinachonuka Mmasai', rinaunganisha arufu mbii ya mmea huno na Amasai. Anaona kukala hiri rinatuluka kpwa vira Adigo kare kala anaamini kukala Amasai 'si atu anono', kpwa sababu kala ni maadui a Adigo kpwenye vihani vya kare.

names.en: The plant has three Digo names. *Mnuka lovu* means 'bad smell', from *nuka*, to smell, and *lovu*, unpleasant. *Chinuka cha m'masai* is the smell of the Maasai. *Mtsatsa*, which Pakia could not analyse, is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. Pakia records *mtsatsa* for two other plants as well: its relative *Clerodendrum incisum* and the shrub *Acalypha fruticosa*. Mgombato uses *mtsatsa* only in the sense of 'seedling'.
names.sw: Mmea huu una majina matatu ya Kidigo. *Mnuka lovu* maana yake ni 'harufu mbaya', kutoka *nuka*, kunuka, na *lovu*, mbaya. *Chinuka cha m'masai* ni harufu ya Mmaasai. *Mtsatsa*, ambalo Pakia hakuweza kulichambua, linashirikiwa na Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Pakia ameandika *mtsatsa* kwa mimea mingine miwili pia: jamaa yake *Clerodendrum incisum* na kichaka *Acalypha fruticosa*. Mgombato inatumia *mtsatsa* kwa maana ya 'mche' tu.
names.dg: Mmea huno una madzina mahahu ga Chidigo. *Mnuka lovu* rina mana ya 'arufu mbii', kula kpwa *nuka*, kulavya arufu, na *lovu*, arufu mbii. *Chinuka cha m'masai* ni arufu ya Mmasai. *Mtsatsa*, ambaro Pakia kaweza kurieleza mana, ni dzina ambaro Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili piya vinaro. Pakia anaandika *mtsatsa* kpwa mimea yanjina miiri piya: nduguye *Clerodendrum incisum*, na chitsaka *Acalypha fruticosa*. Mgombato inahumira *mtsatsa* kpwa mana ya 'mmea mdide uriodzangbwe kukula' (*seedling*) bahi.
